title: Generating a Credit Card Referral Link (Internal)
summary: This internal guide explains how to generate a credit card referral link using the tool `get_referral_link(user_id: str, card_name: str)` (customer runs it themselves with their own user_id and exact card name). It also sets a rolling 7-day weekly limit of 2 referral bonuses (3rd+ is automatically denied) and notes to create referral records with status 'NO_PROGRESS'.
faqs: What pre-checks should we do before giving a customer a referral link tool?
How does the customer generate their referral link, and what inputs are required?
What happens when the referral link tool is called successfully (record status)?
What is the rolling 7-day referral bonus limit, and when are referrals automatically denied?
Are agents allowed to generate a referral link on the customer’s behalf?
If a card has no documented referral program or terms don’t match, should we provide a referral link tool?
